record.scope_note: Borderline as a rule on AI use in one public sector: the State Board of Education binds every Florida school district and charter school governing board to adopt AI safety policies. Included because rules that a government body sets for a whole sector are in scope.

verification.note: Stored in this run, all from official hosts. From flrules.org (the Florida Administrative Code and Register site of the Florida Department of State): the rule page for 6A-1.0957, unchanged since 14 Oct 2026, with the effective date of the latest adopted version and the notice history; the final notice 31488060, with the rule file date (9 Oct 2026) and the effective date (29 Oct 2026); the Florida Administrative Register issues of 26 Aug 2026 (notice of proposed rule with the full proposed text and the hearing date of 16 Sep 2026) and 18 Sep 2026 (notice of change made by the Board); and the text of the rule as adopted, a Word file that has no text layer and so cannot be quoted. From fldoe.org: the Department of Education press release of 16 Sep 2026 saying that the State Board adopted the AI rules that day. The summary follows the proposed text as changed by the notice of change; a plain-text reading of the adopted Word file shows the same provisions.

title.locator: History of this Rule, Development notice 31139151
